verdict.rationale: Background automations are a fair question for an AI app-building agent, but the pack documents no scheduled, triggered, or background agent runs; Bolt's agents work interactively in chat. Automatic GitHub commit sync is an adjacent feature, and Supabase edge functions are a developer building block from a third-party platform, so neither counts as product-level autonomous automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
